notes.highlight: highlight follows iris at 85% of its offset and is clipped by the iris alpha and the eye mask
notes.mapping: cursor position relative to the face center maps to iris offset with a spring (stiffness ~180, damping ~22); both eyes share the same offset
notes.layers: base-no-iris.jpg, then for each eye: iris (translated, clipped by mask), highlight (clipped by mask and iris)

living.note: All motion is done in code (WebGL displacement of the single character image). Eye layers are composited before the warp so they move with the head.

head.note: head moves up when looking up, down when looking down; no roll, only slow sway

pendant_sparkles.order: draw glints and sweep before the warp so they move with the chain

living.idle: after ~4 s without cursor movement the gaze wanders slowly between random points and occasionally glances at a desktop file
living.reduced_motion: no breathing, sway, sparkles or wandering; eyes may follow the cursor with a short fade; blinks off
living.coordinates: all values in pixels of the 2752x1536 base image

eyelids.look_down_droop: overlay blink-lids.png at alpha = 0.32 * max(gazeY, 0) where gazeY is -1 (up) .. 1 (down); blinks use the same layer at alpha 1
